title: Jet64 registry entry — carts/<id>.toml (schema 1)
description: One cart's curator-owned registry entry (docs/cart_exchange/cart_exchange.md §6.2). Documentation of the contract the jcx_validator crate enforces — the crate is authoritative. name, license, and diz are curator-committed copies of facts that originate in the cart's own release, and CI proves them byte-honest against the fetched archive so the index can render every screen without ever fetching one (§6.3).

id.description: The cart's permanent identity; the file must be named <id>.toml.

summary.description: One plain sentence for the listing row (single line).

license.description: SPDX expression from the allowlist (§6.4), equal to the latest release's manifest.

categories.description: 1–4 unique lowercase slugs of curator vocabulary.

repository.description: https://<forge>/<owner>/<name> on a supported forge (github.com, gitlab.com). For forge-scoped ids the owner must be the namespace's account (E19).

provenance.description: E19 evidence for a namespace no forge can prove mechanically, or for an entry a maintainer files on an author's behalf.

diz.description: The author's file_id.diz, verbatim: at most 10 lines of at most 45 printable columns.

version.description: SemVer; unique within the entry. (id, version, tree_sha256) is immutable once accepted (E20).

revision.description: Full commit hash — never a branch or floating tag (E2).

source.description: The canonical forge archive URL derived from repository + revision (§6.5.2); for an unavailable release only, an audited https mirror whose tree fingerprint CI proved identical (§6.7).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive bytes — transport integrity; re-pinnable only via the audited §7.5 path.

tree_sha256.description: The E20 tree fingerprint of the release surface — content identity; never changes.

yanked.description: Removed from default discovery — something was wrong (§6.7).

unavailable.description: Upstream gone, nothing wrong — mirror rules in §6.7.
